input: Compare ACME’s 30-day return policy for regular items vs final-sale items.
expected_output: Regular items can be returned within 30 days of delivery as long as the shoes are unworn or only worn indoors, and are returned in the original box with the receipt or order number. In contrast, sale items marked “final sale” cannot be returned at all.
context:
ACME SHOES - FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

RETURNS AND REFUNDS

All customers are eligible for a 30 day return window from the date of delivery. Shoes must be unworn, or worn only indoors, and returned in the original box with the receipt or order number. Sale items marked "final sale" cannot be returned.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Once we receive your return, refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days. Your bank may take an additional 2 to 3 days to show the credit. Original shipping charges are not refunded unless the return is due to our error.

If your shoes don't fit, you can exchange them for a different size at no extra cost. Exchanges ship free of charge, and the 30 day window does not restart for the replacement pair.

SHIPPING

Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the country and costs 5 dollars. Orders over 75 dollars qualify for free standard shipping. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs 15 dollars.

We ship to over 50 countries. International orders take 7 to 14 business days, and customers are responsible for any customs duties or import taxes.

Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day are shipped the same day. You will receive a tracking number by email once your order ships.

SIZING AND PRODUCTS

Our shoes run true to size for most styles. Our running range runs slightly narrow, so we recommend ordering half a size up if you have wide feet. A size chart is available on every product page.

Our Eco line is made from recycled materials, including recycled polyester uppers and rubber soles made from reclaimed tires. All Eco shoes are machine washable on a cold, gentle cycle. Air dry only, and do not use a tumble dryer.

All shoes include a 12 month warranty against manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear or damage caused by misuse.

STORES AND SUPPORT

Our stores are open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 6 pm, and closed on Sundays and public holidays. We currently operate 12 stores. A store locator is available on our website.

Customer support is available by email at support@acmeshoes.example and by phone on weekdays from 9 am to 5 pm. Email replies are sent within 24 hours on business days.

PAYMENT AND ORDERS

We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal. Orders can be cancelled free of charge within 1 hour of placing them. After that, the order may already be in packing, and you will need to use the return process instead.

Gift cards are valid for 24 months from the date of purchase and can be used online or in any store. Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash.
